newsitem.title: USA: Pride Petroleum names Paul Bragg president.
newsitem.headline: Pride Petroleum names Paul Bragg president.

text.p: Pride Petroleum Services Inc said Wednesday that Paul Bragg has been appointed president and chief operating officer and Earl McNiel has been appointed vice president and chief financial officer.

Previously, the company said, Bragg served as vice president and chief financial officer. He takes over the presidency from Ray Tolson, who will continue as chairman of the board and chief executive, the company said.
NcNiel has served as chief accounting officer of Pride since 1994, the company said.
